ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line segment $AB=24\,cm$, C is a point on $AB$, and $AC=15\,cm$, O is the midpoint of $AB$. What is the length of line segment $OC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since AB=24cm, and point O is the midpoint of AB,\\
then OB=$\frac{1}{2}$AB=$\frac{1}{2}\times 24=12cm$,\\
Since BC=AB−AC,\\
then BC=24−15=9;\\
Since OC=OB−BC,\\
then OC=12−9=$\boxed{3}$cm.
